metadata.title: Enphase Will Have to Grow Its Way Out of a Bleak Residential Solar Market.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Enphase Stock Sinks. It Will Have to Grow Its Way Out of a Bleak Residential Solar Market.
If Enphase Energy stock on Wednesday is any indication, that might be it for when it comes to the residential solar market in the U.S.—at least for awhile.
